counterexamples: A caller that passed 0-based pages would be correct.

defects.evidence: pager.py now computes the offset as page * size, while views.py still passes a 1-based page.
defects.fix_or_counterexample: Keep (page - 1) * size, or convert the caller.
defects.impact: The first page shows the second page of rows; the first rows are never shown and the last page is empty.
defects.match_criteria: Identify the off-by-one page offset or that 1-based callers now skip the first page.
defects.trigger: Open the first page of any list view.
